items.title: Billionaire venture capitalist Vinod Khosla says judge AI by usage, not stock prices
items.summary: Vinod Khosla, the billionaire Sun Microsystems co-founder and early OpenAI backer, says usage is the number to watch, not the stock market's mood swings.

items.title: Constellation Energy’s Dividend Is Small. AI Power Demand Could Change That
items.summary: Constellation Energy just raised guidance for the second time this year, yet its payout barely registers. Tech giants are signing decades-long power deals, but management is spending cash somewhere other than dividends. Here is what income investors should watch.

items.title: CoreWeave surges, but bigger tests loom for the AI trade
items.summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) jumped 24% in morning trading as the company beat on third quarter sales estimates. The rally offers a much-needed boost to AI investors, but bigger tests lie ahead, with Nvidia  (NVDA) earnings next week and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) preparing for a potential IPO. Host Kevin Kelly, Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO, and his panel of experts weigh in.Today's panel includes EP Wealth Advisors Managing Director of Investments Adam Phillips, Zacks Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Brian Mulberry, and ProShares Global Investment Strategist Simeon Hyman.

items.title: Saucony, Merrell Again to Headline Wolverine’s Q3 Earnings Results
items.summary: Analysts see continued growth at the Merrell and Saucony brands when Wolverine World Wide reports third quarter earnings Thursday.

items.title: This Number Tells Me The Microsoft Data Center Selloff Is Excessive, Prompting Me to Buy
items.summary: Wall Street sees Microsoft's data center spending as a cash bonfire, and the stock keeps sliding. One overlooked figure on the balance sheet changes how that spending looks, and it explains why one investor keeps buying every dip.

items.title: Microsoft Stock Suddenly Has an Anthropic Problem

items.title: Google and Meta fight new rule that could change online news
items.summary: The bill would require digital platforms to compensate news publishers for displaying content links and introduce rules covering AI.

items.title: Alphabet Stocks Rise as Google Commits $10 Billion to Anthropic IPO
